column1: # Mechanical rewrites of the IEEE 1076-2019 package sources that make the derived
# packages of the older standards valid VHDL of their own standard
# files (decl, body or both), rule, item key (* = the whole file), arguments,
# clause, reason.  Rules: copy_as (the item becomes a copy of the item named by
# from= with the subst= identifiers old:new replaced), duplicate (a copy of the
# item with subst= follows it), substitute (identifiers replaced in the item or
# the whole file), drop_end_kind (the kind keyword after end is dropped),
# omit_file (the file is not shipped).  No rewrite adds text that is not a copy
